ActivitiesPage.title: Waxyaabaha lagu sameeyo Minneapolis iyo St. Paul

card-1.title: Waddada Cun
card-1.description: Ururinta kala duwan ee makhaayadaha caalamiga ah
card-1.details: Ku sahamin cunnooyinka kala duwan ee adduunka oo dhan dhanka Nicollet Avenue, oo loo yaqaan 'Eat Street'. Laga soo bilaabo pho Vietnamese ilaa schnitzel Jarmal, waxaa jira wax loogu talagalay dhadhan kasta.
card-1.cost: Waxay ku kala duwan tahay makhaayadda, guud ahaan $10-$30 qofkiiba

card-2.title: Suuqa Caalamiga ah ee Midtown
card-2.description: Gudaha suuqa guud ee caalamiga ah
card-2.details: Booqo suuqan firfircoon ee ka muuqda iibiyeyaasha cuntada, makhaayadaha, iyo hadiyadaha gaarka ah ee adduunka oo dhan. Ha seegin fursadda aad ku tijaabin karto cuntooyinka dhaqamada kala duwan oo dhan hal saqafka hoostiisa.
card-2.cost: Gelitaanka bilaashka ah, qiimaha cuntadu waa kala duwan yahay

card-3.title: Suuqa Beeralayda ee St. Paul
card-3.description: Wax soo saar cusub oo maxali ah iyo alaab farshaxan
card-3.details: Kala hel sida ugu wanaagsan ee wax soo saarka gudaha Minnesota iyo alaabada farshaxanimada suuqan taariikhiga ah ee beeralayda. Furan sanadka oo dhan, waa meel aad u fiican in laga muunadeeyo cuntooyinka cusub oo lala kulmo soosaarayaasha maxalliga ah.
card-3.cost: Gelitaanka bilaashka ah, qiimayaashu way kala duwan yihiin iibiyaha

card-4.title: Myriel
card-4.description: Cunto saaxiibtinimo leh ayaa la socota koob kafee ukun ah
card-4.details: Liiska a la carte lagama heli karo onlayn sababta oo ah marar badan ayay is beddeshaa. Tomlinson waxa uu sameeyaa qolof caan ah: Haddii tufaax tufaax ahi ka soo muuqdo menu-ka, dalbo adoon ka labalabayn, oo ku lammaane macmacaan kafee ukun Scandinavian ah.

card-1.title: Machadka Fanka ee Minneapolis
card-1.description: Matxaf farshaxan heer caalami ah oo bilaash ah
card-1.details: Sahami in ka badan 90,000 oo farshaxanimo ah oo soconaya 5,000 oo sano oo hal-abuurnimo aadanaha ah. Laga soo bilaabo farshaxan qadiim ah ilaa farshaxan-gacmeedyada casriga ah, MIA waxay siisaa khibrad kala duwan oo kobcinaysa dadka fanka jecel.
card-1.cost: Gelitaanka guud ee bilaashka ah, bandhigyada gaarka ah qaarkood ayaa laga yaabaa inay leeyihiin lacag

card-2.title: Mall of America
card-2.description: Suuqa ugu weyn ee laga dukaameysto ee Maraykanka
card-2.details: In ka badan dukaamaysiga, Mall of America waxay leedahay jardiinooyin gudaha ah, aquarium, iyo doorashooyin madadaalo aan tiro lahayn. Waa magaalo ku dhex taal magaalada iyo soo jiidashada qasabka ah.
card-2.cost: Gelitaanka bilaashka ah, kharashyadu way kala duwan yihiin meelaha soo jiidashada iyo wax iibsiga

card-3.title: Minnehaha Falls
card-3.description: Biyo-dhac 53-foot ah oo ku yaal meel magaalo ah
card-3.details: Ku raaxayso quruxda dabiiciga ah ee Minnehaha Falls, oo ku taal Beerta Minnehaha. Qaado socod muuqaal ah, qaado dalxiis, ama si fudud ugu naso biyaha qulqulaya ee ku yaal xeebta magaalada.

card-4.title: Matxafka Sayniska ee Minnesota
card-4.description: Matxafka sayniska isdhexgalka oo leh aragtiyo wabi oo cajiib ah
card-4.details: La qabso bandhigyo gacma-qabsi ah, ka qabso bandhiga Omnitheater, oo wax kasta ka baro dinosaurs ilaa jidhka bini'aadamka. Matxafku wuxuu bixiyaa aragtiyo cajiib ah oo ku saabsan Wabiga Mississippi.

content.hotel-description: La kulan wadnaha faras-magaalaha Minneapolis hudheelka shirarka. Ku raaxayso waxyaabaha casriga ah, qolal waasac ah, iyo si fudud u geli meelaha soo jiidashada leh.

card.title: Qorshayaasha Dabaqa Shirka
card.content: Hudheelkayagu waxa uu bixiyaa goobo dhacdooyin badan leh si loo dejiyo dhammaan hawlaha shirka Laga soo bilaabo qolal ballaadhineed ilaa qolal kulan oo dhow, waxaan leenahay goobta ugu fiican ee fadhi kasta.

card.description: Raaxo iyo raaxaysi dhammaan ka qaybgalayaasha
card.content: Ku raaxayso joogitaan raaxo leh oo leh adeegyo kala duwan oo loogu talagalay in lagu wanaajiyo khibradaada shirka. Laga soo bilaabo ku xirnaanta WiFi bilaashka ah ilaa la socoshada jadwalkaaga jirdhiska, waanu ku daboolnay.

title.title: 65aad ICYPAA
title.subtitle: Shirka Caalamiga ah ee Dhallinyarada ee AA

item-1.content: ICYPAA waxay u taagan tahay Shirka Caalamiga ah ee Dhallinyarada Alcoholics Anonymous.

item-2.trigger: Yaa ka qayb gali kara ICYPAA?
item-2.content: ICYPAA waxay u furan tahay qof kasta oo raba inuu joojiyo khamriga, iyadoon loo eegayn da'da. Iyadoo diiradda lagu saarayo dhalinyarada, dhammaan waa lagu soo dhaweynayaa inay ka soo qaybgalaan oo ka qaybgalaan.

item-3.trigger: Sideen isu diiwaan gelin karaa shirka?
item-3.content: Waxaad iska diiwaan gelin kartaa shirka adigoo gujinaya "Diiwaangeli Hadda" badhanka sare ee boggan.

item-4.content: Haa, deeqo waxbarasho ayaa diyaar ah. Fadlan ka hubi bogga diiwaangelinta si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan sida loo codsado.

contact.title: Nala Soo Xidhiidh
contact.description: Haddii aad qabto wax su'aalo ah ama aad u baahan tahay macluumaad dheeraad ah, fadlan ha ka waaban inaad nala soo xiriirto.
